name: South Africa (SANS 10160, SANS 10100, SANS 10162)
description: The South African National Standards (alpha 9 track C24), a pack that extends the built-in pack eurocodes: SANS 10160:2011 follows EN 1990 / EN 1991 / EN 1998 with South African values. Loads: the SANS 10160-1 STR combinations (1.35G, 1.2G + 1.6Q (+ 0.6W), 1.2G + 1.3W + 0.5Q, 0.9G + 1.3W, G + 0.3Q + E) as a set of the parent's strengthSets; wind by the parent's EN 1991-1-4 method with the towns' fundamental basic wind speed vb,0 of SANS 10160-3 (36-44 m/s); seismic by SANS 10160-4 (the towns' peak ground acceleration ag, 0.05-0.15 g with the mining areas, the ground types 1-4 with S, TB, TC, TD, the importance factors 0.8-1.4) on the parent's EN 1998-1 design spectrum, behaviour factors and rules. Concrete: SANS 10100-1 is a BS 8110 type code on the cube strength; this pack keeps the parent's EN 1992-1-1 methods (a pack has one parent: the loads decide it) with SANS 10100-1's γm 1.5 and 1.15 and αcc 0.85 (0.67 fcu/γm ≈ 0.85 fck/γm): SANS 10100-1's own shear, detailing and deflection values are not set. Steel: SANS 10162-1 (a CSA S16 type code) is not set: the parent's EN 1993-1-1 applies and the report names it. Every value is listed in VERIFY.md; the towns' ag and vb,0, the ground type parameters and the combinations' ψ are uncertain and must be checked before design.
